svg.title: Escape Room Adventure | Automatic acquisition and fresh two-gate output

g.text: Escape Room Adventure | Automatic acquisition and fresh two-gate output
ItemLock and exit Trivia may finish in either order. There are seven use cases.
Every success, error and changed=false result produces fresh immutable output.
Each response renders before the next depicted input. Missing Game uses
fromNoGame(message) and the same presenter -> EDT model -> View completion.
Commands use one serial worker. Getters, output assembly and rendering never acquire items.
Presenter constructs ViewState inside its EDT callback, preserving CURRENT busy.
finally queues an EDT completion AFTER output; it clears UI busy + admission guard together.
Another command is admitted only after that result render/completion.
new game: starting visible items are acquired before its first output
Load template through the story port; GameFactory.create constructs a candidate.
Its new-game constructor invokes private enterRoom(startingRoomId) before publication:
resolve room, obtain visibleCollectables IDs, preflight ALL transfers, then enter/acquire.
The same original items become revealed INVENTORY items; no duplicate instances.
Future-room visible items stay in ROOM until normal entry.
interaction: automatic appearance, failed input or repeated item IDs
[supplied item resolved, or no item supplied]
For EACH appearance ID, skip it if already in inventory.
Otherwise require the remaining local ROOM item.
Validate ALL IDs before any object effect, completion or location mutation.
Authored appearingItemIds refer to original items of this action's own room.
[each appearance ID not already in inventory]
Repeated IDs yield no duplicate and no second Obtained notice.
Other valid repeatable state effects may still change the room.
State effects never transfer items or unlock either gate.
ItemLock attempt checks the complete inventory
Equal counts with wrong IDs still fail.
Door checks leave every item held.
Trivia.open: cached, fetched, API failure or invalid target
Question and gate remain unchanged; opening may be retried.
Trivia.submit: correct, wrong, uninitialized or repeated answer
Submit NEVER calls API. An uninitialized attempt changes no question/gate state.
Correct completion of the second gate enables movement in this refreshed view.
movement: enter/acquire atomically, escape or remain blocked
Label = finalRoom ? Escape : Next room; enabled by canMove.
No destination selector or successor ID enters UI output.
Save/load retains schema 4 and the existing predecessor-gates validation.
Compatible immutable template versions define successors and appearance-item rules.
Restore uses state construction, never enterRoom/acquireItems; it replays no action or acquisition.
Load and later refresh display existing inventory without another Obtained notice.
No acquisition ledger or additional output field is introduced.
Detailed save/load success/error response cycles: escape-room-save-sequence.puml.
